description: List CaptionsEasy's designed caption looks (99). Each has a permanent `number` and an `id`; pass either to build_captions / caption_video. Filter with `query` (free text over name, description, tags and section, e.g. "bold", "neon", "subtitle", "one word", "karaoke") or `section` (viral, popular, premium, trending, creator, dynamic, typography, simple, paper, plus clean/fun/retro/tech...). `layout: word` looks show one word at a time (punchy Shorts/TikTok); sentence/karaoke looks show short phrases (talking heads, tutorials).
name: list_looks
title: List caption looks
